channel.title: OpenTrustBench changelog
channel.description: Releases, registry refreshes, and methodology updates for the OpenTrustBench agent trust scanner.

item.title: Coverage integrity v2: U grade + trust-card/v2
item.description: Trust-card/v2 ships: U (ungraded) where static coverage is insufficient, coverage object in every card, exit code 2. Registry recomputed: 3 graded, 50 ungraded.

item.title: Weekly registry refresh goes automatic
item.description: 50 MCP servers re-scanned on schedule; per-report badges bound to evidence pages; stale banners past 30 days.

item.title: State of MCP Permissions: 50 servers scanned
item.description: Average 70.2 (C); 36% grade D or F; permission scope predicts the grade. Full methodology and tables. (Pre-gating figures; superseded by coverage integrity v2 on 2026-09-18 — see changelog.)

item.title: v0.1.3: verified CLI banner + badge rebrand
item.description: CLI banner redrawn from real figlet output; grade badges and OG image carry the OpenTrustBench brand.

item.title: v0.1.2: ASCII banner rebrand + npm READMEs
item.description: CLI banner now reads OpenTrustBench; @opentrustbench/cli and @opentrustbench/core ship package READMEs.

item.title: v0.1.1: Trust Cards for AI agents and MCP servers
item.description: 8-rule OWASP-mapped static suite, Trust Cards A-F, SARIF output, CI gate, GitHub Action, Homebrew + PyPI + VS Code distribution.
